cost_model.commission: per trade + per share, charged on |delta shares| at every fill (a daily flip from +1 to -1 trades ~2x capital)
cost_model.null: coin-flip sign null run on the same segments under the same cost config, so the matched null absorbs the same cost drag
cost_model.sizing: constant-dollar: target = weight * initial_capital, so a round trip is ~2x capital and the cost drag is deterministic
cost_model.slippage: fixed cents/share + proportional, added to the close fill price (close-only pricing, no open/high/low lookahead)

cross_consistency.interpretation: The zero-cost column of this artifact is expected to DISAGREE with the pre-2026-11-22 momentum artifacts because those artifacts encode the degenerate mean-log-price signal; the disagreement is the evidence that the old momentum verdicts described buy-and-hold, not momentum.
